meta.title: OpenCode Web 1.18.18 Gate B capability map
meta.supportedNowMeaning: Gate C will implement the complete bridge+iOS path. It does not mean current product code already supports the surface. supported now + source-only is a product-scope commitment only, not implementation authorization.
meta.supportedNowAndSourceOnly: Product scope only, not an implementation grant. Source citations alone do not authorize writing event/response translators.
meta.gateSPreSampleRule: For every translated behavior whose Gate B row is source-only (no same-version captured sample), the Gate S C-slice impact record and S4 test map MUST register a prerequisite gate of 实现前补样本. Do not start that slice's event/response translation from source citations alone.

ownerDecisions.title: Archived session default visibility
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Match official Web reducer: default home/global list hides rows with time.archived; GET-by-id still returns archived sessions; do not treat API list membership as UI visibility.
ownerDecisions.evidence: A10: API roots=true still includes archived; GET /session/:id returns time.archived; official event-reducer.ts:149-161 splices archived out of the home list. Current CordCode maps ArchivedAt and comments say clients hide them.
ownerDecisions.impact: iOS session home list, get_session, archive mutation refresh. Choosing 'show archived in default list' would diverge from official Web.
ownerDecisions.resolvedSummary: Default home/global list hides sessions with time.archived; GET-by-id still returns archived sessions.

ownerDecisions.title: Multi-directory session aggregation
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Keep CordCode product overlay: iOS global list aggregates one official directory-scoped GET /session per project worktree. Per-directory requests use the official scoped list only. Do not treat the official Web single-directory home list as a ban on CordCode aggregation.
ownerDecisions.evidence: A10: two directories do not leak ids. Official session-load.ts lists one directory. Current ListSessions in sessions.go already fans out per projectDirectories.
ownerDecisions.impact: iOS global session catalog versus per-workspace filter. Dropping aggregation would hide sessions outside the current work dir.
ownerDecisions.resolvedSummary: iOS global list aggregates one official directory-scoped GET /session per project worktree; per-directory requests stay scoped.

ownerDecisions.title: C7 extras in the first convergence slice
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Leave all of these as mapped (future or deliberately unsupported). Do not pull them into the first Gate C slice without a new sample pack.
ownerDecisions.evidence: Plan §6 C7 says select only from this map. None of these have a Gate A P0 sample except children/list facts inside A10.
ownerDecisions.impact: Advertised iOS session/workspace commands. Promoting any item to supported now expands C7 scope.
ownerDecisions.resolvedSummary: First C slice does not promote mapped future or deliberately unsupported C7 extras.
